findings.passage: “Voting by mail is both safe and bipartisan.
findings.note: Statement on his official site answering the President's claim that California's vote-by-mail system is rigged; he says he wrote the 2021 law making California a universal vote-by-mail state and calls the fraud claims baseless.
subjects: election integrity and voter fraud claims

findings.passage: Faced with the potential for massive and embarrassing losses in the midterms, Trump is now trying to erect as many unnecessary barriers as possible to voting, with the goal of disenfranchising millions of Americans who are tired of his incompetence, corruption, and cruelty.
findings.note: Statement on his official site about the federal executive order restricting mail-in voting. The same release says he chaired the Assembly Elections Committee from 2017 to 2021 and authored AB 860 (2020) and AB 37 (2021) on mail ballots.
subjects: election integrity and voter fraud claims

findings.passage: If President Trump wants to make America’s elections more secure, I suggest he start with the man in the mirror.
findings.note: Statement on his official site responding to a presidential national address about election security; he rejects the fraud claims about prior elections.
subjects: election integrity and voter fraud claims

findings.passage: California will keep every eligible voter’s mail ballot secure and accessible, and we’ll be back in court immediately if Trump tries to overreach into state election administration."
findings.note: Statement on his official site about a Supreme Court decision on the executive order limiting mail-in voting.
